title: Recipe
description: Crispy, golden, and perfectly seasoned fresh-cut french fries made effortlessly in your toaster oven air fryer. A healthier, vegan-friendly alternative to deep-fried potatoes.
name: Vegan Toaster Oven Air Fryer French Fries
instructions: Wash and scrub the potatoes thoroughly. Cut them into uniform 1/4-inch thick fries. Peeling is optional.
Place the cut fries into a large bowl of cold water and let them soak for at least 30 minutes. This removes excess starch and helps them get crispier.
Preheat your toaster oven air fryer to 400°F (200°C) on the air fry setting.
Drain the potatoes and pat them completely dry with a clean kitchen towel or paper towels. This step is crucial for achieving a crispy texture.
In a large, dry bowl, toss the potato fries with olive oil until they are lightly and evenly coated.
In a small separate bowl, mix together the salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the seasoning mix over the oiled fries and toss again to ensure they are evenly seasoned.
Arrange the fries in a single layer in the air fryer basket or tray. Do not overcrowd the basket; cook in batches if necessary to ensure even cooking.
Air fry for 15-20 minutes, shaking the basket or flipping the fries halfway through the cooking time, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve immediately with your favorite vegan dipping sauce like ketchup or vegan aioli.
notes: For extra crispy fries, soak the potatoes for a longer period (up to 2 hours), changing the water once. Ensure potatoes are completely dry before adding oil. Feel free to experiment with other seasonings like onion powder, chili powder, or dried herbs like rosemary.
